title: Argentina Rallies Past England 2-1 in Atlanta; First-Ever Spain vs Argentina Final Set
detail: Argentina came from behind to beat England 2-1 in Atlanta, with Lionel Messi again a driving factor in a late rally, sending Argentina into the World Cup final for the first time since 2022. England will instead play France in the third-place playoff. The final -- Spain vs Argentina, Sunday July 19 at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey -- is the first-ever World Cup final meeting between the two nations.

media.caption: Messi fuels Argentina's rally past England, setting up the first-ever Spain vs Argentina World Cup final
